messages.subject: Executive Value Creation Brief | AFRY | Sustainability Consulting
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Kähö,

I am sharing a strategic value creation brief prepared for AFRY, focused on sustainability consulting, resilient infrastructure, transition strategy, client value creation and multi-stakeholder implementation. My current work spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and cross-functional execution in a multinational mining environment.

The attached brief outlines areas where this operating experience could complement advisory and implementation mandates. I would welcome a short discussion regarding senior leadership or strategic roles where my background would add value.

Regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Brief for AFRY
strategic_brief.prepared_for_title: Head of Sustainability Consulting | AFRY Management Consulting
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Ragunauth Ramsaroop offers an operating leadership profile aligned with AFRY's sustainability consulting agenda across resilient infrastructure, transition strategy, stakeholder governance and implementation. His experience combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships, social performance and executive advisory in a multinational mining environment. He works across operations, legal, finance, procurement, HR, security and technical teams, translating external obligations into coordinated execution. For AFRY, his strongest contribution would be bringing owner-side implementation experience into assignments where clients need sustainability strategy connected to regulatory reality, operational ownership, stakeholder expectations and measurable delivery rather than stand-alone advisory outputs.
strategic_brief.company_context: AFRY is executing its Unlocking AFRY strategy while providing engineering, project management and advisory services across energy, industry and infrastructure. Its 2026 reporting emphasizes restructuring, growth, sustainability and client value, while its annual sustainability reporting is prepared under the CSRD framework. This creates an opportunity to differentiate consulting through strong implementation discipline: clients increasingly need support not only with strategy and reporting, but also with governance, regulatory coordination, stakeholder engagement and evidence ownership inside operating businesses. A leader with direct experience managing these interfaces in a complex industrial setting can help bridge recommendations and execution while strengthening practical relevance for senior client teams.

opportunities.title: Implementation-led sustainability advisory
opportunities.rationale: Clients increasingly need sustainability strategies translated into accountable operating plans, data ownership, governance and executive decision routines rather than recommendations that remain separated from day-to-day execution.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can bring owner-side experience to design implementation models that connect regulatory obligations, ESG targets, operating teams, evidence sources and management accountability.

opportunities.title: Stakeholder and regulatory strategy
opportunities.rationale: Energy, mining and infrastructure projects face interconnected government, regulator, community and investor expectations. Advisory value rises when stakeholder strategy is integrated with technical and commercial delivery.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can support stakeholder mapping, regulatory coordination, engagement architecture and issue governance grounded in direct experience managing public authorities and complex operating interfaces.

opportunities.title: Assurance-ready transformation
opportunities.rationale: CSRD and other sustainability requirements create demand for reliable evidence, defined ownership and transparent controls that withstand executive, auditor and stakeholder scrutiny across client organizations.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I can help build evidence registers, accountability matrices and review routines that translate reporting requirements into practical management systems and measurable operating actions.

days_0_30: Identify priority sectors, client pain points and implementation gaps where owner-side experience adds value.
days_31_60: Develop repeatable governance, stakeholder and evidence-assurance modules for client engagements.
days_61_90: Pilot the approach on selected sustainability and infrastructure mandates.
days_91_180: Codify lessons, impact measures and scalable delivery practices across consulting teams.

potential_impact: Stronger connection between sustainability advice and client execution.
More practical stakeholder and regulatory strategies for industrial clients.
Improved assurance readiness and governance within client programmes.
background_relevance: Direct ESG and sustainability execution inside a multinational mining business.
Government and regulatory relations across multiple public authorities.
Cross-functional implementation with operations, technical, legal, finance, procurement and executive teams.
